statement: The admin CDC notification proof separates cache-listener delivery from live authoritative-repair ownership: its INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE witness cannot be preempted or impersonated by an authoritative absence sweep, the production AdminWebSocketAPI-to-SystemTableCache listener path and cache causal fencing remain unchanged, and the exact release proof passes before a forward 0.2 patch release is tagged.

constraints.statement: Treat the failure as an interaction between the cache mutation owner, authoritative absence repair, asynchronous notification delivery, and the test harness; do not tune waits or weaken assertions.
A cache-notification witness must have exactly one mutation owner. A live authoritative repair loop may be exercised only when its competing mutation is itself the subject of the test.
Do not weaken tombstone fencing, causal ordering, authoritative absence reconciliation, AdminWebSocketAPI subscription lifecycle, or asynchronous listener isolation.

Retain a deterministic witness showing that an authoritative sweep cannot satisfy or preempt the intended INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE notification assertions; repeated timing stress alone is insufficient.
The immutable v0.2.1 tag is never moved or deleted. If committed bytes change, publish the repaired head and release forward as the next 0.2 patch only after exact-SHA CI and release preflight pass.
